source.note: combo witness of the PERMANENT bounce->recast EDGE (CR 601.2 / 603.6e / 400.7): a returntohand:permanent BOUNCE (battlefield->hand) refueling a mana-paying RECAST that re-enters an ETB creature, re-firing its self-ETB. The PERMANENT dual of policy:recast:spell-recursion (which returns a SPELL from=graveyard to=HAND and feeds a cast:spell:self driver) and DISTINCT from blink (deployment:creature[manner=blink]) which returns the permanent directly to the BATTLEFIELD, mana-free, no hand step. Here the return goes to HAND and the permanent must be RE-CAST paying full mana (guard:recast-pays-mana). Both cards' load-bearing ports are AST-derivable and served by the live engine (dumps/card-ports.json, 2026-07-17): Cloudstone Curio -> emit:returntohand:permanent (family=recur, tier=Amber, the bounce) + etb:permanent:controlled (family=etb, consume, the 'whenever a nonartifact permanent you control enters' watcher); Priest of Gix -> emit:mana:black (family=mana, adds {B}{B}{B}) + etb:creature:self (family=etb, consume, isSelf=true). VERIFIED oracle text: Cloudstone Curio = 'Whenever a nonartifact permanent you control enters, you may return another permanent you control that shares a permanent type with it to its owner's hand.'; Priest of Gix = 'When this creature enters, add {B}{B}{B}.' The loop needs TWO permanents sharing a permanent type (Cloudstone returns ANOTHER permanent, guard:exclude-self) -- e.g. two Priest of Gix (both Creatures): cast Priest B -> its ETB adds {B}{B}{B} + Cloudstone triggers -> return Priest A to hand -> recast Priest A ({2}{B}) -> its ETB adds {B}{B}{B} + Cloudstone returns Priest B -> ... a self-sustaining infinite-ETB engine. MANA ECONOMICS (honest): each recast is {2}{B} and each ETB yields {B}{B}{B}, so the loop is mana-NEUTRAL (parity holds: {B}{B}{B} refills {2}{B}) -- unlike a GENERIC hand-bounce loop, which is mana-NEGATIVE and merely bounded. So mana is NOT this loop's floor; the AMBER floor is (a) Cloudstone's bounce is OPTIONAL ('you MAY return', CR 603) and (b) 'another permanent ... that shares a permanent type' is PRODUCER-CHOICE which permanent -> Overlaps the specific creature to recast (object identity the operator can't see) -> policy:recast:permanent-bounce's Overlaps->AMBER branch, exactly mirroring spell-recursion's targeted-return Overlaps. MODELING SEAM (honest, NOT a parse gap in the endpoints): the intermediate 'recast re-entry' (the permanent redeploy) is the RULES recast (CR 601.2, any card in a castable zone is castable), NOT a card-text-parsed port; and a dedicated permanent recast-DRIVER consume (cast:creature:self) is NOT AST-derivable for a vanilla ETB creature (the parser emits cast:spell:self only for the 112 self-cast-referencing cards; Priest of Gix has none). So the witnessed edge E1 lands the bounce faithfully on Priest's REAL etb:creature:self (the recast re-enters it and re-fires it) rather than on a non-existent recast-driver port, and the Cloudstone re-trigger that closes the cycle is left an implicit hop (Deadeye-style: deadeye-x-peregrine-drake draws only its 2 cross-card edges). No source.popularity COUNT is available in the testbed corpus (edhrec/price absent) so it is omitted (not fabricated); csb=true records this is a documented Commander Spellbook engine (Cloudstone Curio + two ETB-mana creatures = infinite ETB triggers). SCAFFOLD SURFACE: this witnesses the `recur` stem with from=battlefield (a battlefield->hand BOUNCE), where archaeomancer used from=graveyard -- from=battlefield is already in the `from` axis values_seen and `recur` is a licensed `from` stem, so no new axis is invented; only the recur-from=battlefield combination accretes.

judge.ref: interaction-judge PASS (accretion batch 10, 2026-07-17): 9/9 PASS, no false GREEN. Both new recast members (policy:recast:graveyard-cast, policy:recast:permanent-bounce) ruled genuinely distinct (from-zone/end-state/consume-side); persist ruled a correct corroboration of policy:recur:death-return-self + guard:undying-counter-reset (sign-of-counter differs, mechanism identical), not a sibling.

Cloudstone Curio.note: THE ENTRY WATCHER -- 'Whenever a nonartifact permanent you control enters' (live etb:permanent:controlled; family=etb, consume). Bare `deployment` with control=you, mirroring chatterfang C1's 'a permanent you control enters' watcher; the nonartifact restriction is a filter detail on the watch. Re-fired every time a shared-type permanent re-enters -> drives the bounce (CC2).

THE EMIT SIDE OF THE WITNESSED EDGE -- 'return another permanent you control ... to its owner's hand' (live emit:returntohand:permanent; family=recur, tier=Amber). A BOUNCE: from=battlefield (the returned permanent is on the battlefield, AST-proven) and to=hand (definitional to return-to-hand) -- distinct from archaeomancer's recur[from=graveyard]. WHICH permanent is returned is producer-choice ('another permanent ... that shares a permanent type'), the Overlap that floors the recast edge to AMBER. In the loop the player returns the OTHER shared-type creature -> hand, to be recast.

Priest of Gix.note: THE CONSUME SIDE OF THE WITNESSED EDGE -- the ETB driver 'When this creature enters' (live etb:creature:self; family=etb, consume, isSelf=true). A self-watching ETB; when Priest is bounced to hand and RE-CAST, it re-enters as a new object (CR 603.6e/400.7) and this ETB re-fires. The recast re-entry is genuinely SELF (the same card recast), so this ETB fires on identity -- the Overlap that caps the edge is on Cloudstone's producer-choice RETURN (which permanent), not on this self-ETB. Mirrors archaeomancer A0, deadeye PD1, mulldrifter MU0.

the ETB payoff grounding the loop's mana balance -- 'add {B}{B}{B}' (live emit:mana:black; family=mana). qty=3 black; refills the {2}{B} recast ({B}{B}{B} covers {2}{B}) -> the loop is mana-NEUTRAL (parity), the reason this bounce loop sustains where a generic mana-negative one only bounds. control=you and color=black are AST-derivable.

notes: THE WITNESSED EDGE (permanent bounce->recast, CR 601.2/603.6e/400.7). Cloudstone's emit:returntohand:permanent lands the returned permanent in HAND (to=hand, a castable zone) -> the player RE-CASTS it paying full mana (guard:recast-pays-mana; {2}{B} here) -> it re-enters as a new object and re-fires Priest's etb:creature:self (PG1). The PERMANENT dual of policy:recast:spell-recursion: SPELL vs permanent, from=graveyard vs from=battlefield, terminating at a cast-driver vs at the redeploy's self-ETB. WHICH permanent Cloudstone returns is producer-choice ('another permanent that shares a permanent type') so the returned card Overlaps the specific creature to recast -> Overlaps->AMBER, mirroring spell-recursion's targeted-return AMBER. guard:recast-pays-mana is the mana co-cost the arm always carries (here refilled by PG2's {B}{B}{B} -> parity, so it does not floor THIS loop, but it is why a generic hand-bounce loop is mana-negative). guard:exclude-self documents that Cloudstone returns ANOTHER permanent -> the loop needs a SECOND shared-type permanent (two Priest of Gix), it can never self-loop on one card.

Priest's ETB deterministically adds {B}{B}{B} -- a self-certifying card-defined flow from the ETB subscription to the mana emit, no rule dependency. Grounds PG1 as a real value ETB and supplies the loop's mana refill (parity with the {2}{B} recast). Mirrors archaeomancer E1, mulldrifter E2.

Cloudstone's entry-trigger deterministically resolves into its return effect -- a self-certifying card-defined flow from the watcher (CC1) to the bounce emit (CC2). The trigger itself is mandatory (a triggered ability always triggers, CR 603.2); the OPTIONAL 'you may return' is a reliability cap carried by the loop_tier/E1 Overlap, not a tier floor on this structural fire.

match_policy.subject: intersect
match_policy.desc: a returntohand:permanent BOUNCE emit (from=battlefield -> to=hand, a permanent returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand) refuels the RECAST of the bounced permanent: recast from hand (CR 601.2, full mana repaid -> guard:recast-pays-mana), the permanent re-enters as a new object (CR 603.6e/400.7) and re-fires its self-ETB subscription. The PERMANENT dual of policy:recast:spell-recursion, distinct on three axes: (1) the returned object is a PERMANENT with an ETB, not an instant/sorcery SPELL with a cast trigger; (2) from=BATTLEFIELD (a bounce), not from=graveyard (graveyard recursion); (3) it terminates at the redeploy's self-ETB (a permanent's recast IS its re-entry), not at a cast:spell:self driver. Distinct from blink (deployment:creature[manner=blink], a DIRECT battlefield return, mana-free, no hand step) and from policy:recast:battlefield-return (a self-CAST from=graveyard directly ONTO the battlefield, CR 601.3). Feasible when the returned permanent's type Intersects the recast target; the operator tiers Subsumes->GREEN / Overlaps->AMBER -- a producer-choice return ('return ANOTHER permanent that shares a permanent type') Overlaps the specific creature the player wants to recast -> AMBER. Any loop closed by this bounce-recast carries the recast mana co-cost (guard:recast-pays-mana) and floors below GREEN unless the loop provably refills it in the right color (Priest of Gix's {B}{B}{B} refills {2}{B} -> mana parity, still AMBER via the producer-choice/'may' Overlap).

guards.desc: a recast emit (emit:cast - a spell bounced/returned to a castable zone and cast again, CR 601) re-pays the spell's full mana cost every iteration. A cast-loop that is closed BY a recast therefore carries an irreducible mana co-cost: the loop is sound (GREEN-eligible) only if it provably refills that cost; unrefilled - or refilled only through an AMBER mana bridge (untap->mana) - the loop floors to AMBER (ADR-0003 §8 mana balance). Caps the cast->cast-trigger edge that the recast closes.
